note: QTI 3.0 defines 21 interactions. Its naming vocabulary is adopted as a naming reference (research.md P6); QTI's XML binding is not implemented. RF-3/RF-4 cover the textual/list-based interactions; the graphical/image-based and numeric/slider family have NO assigned RF yet in requirements.md (a scope finding, not a naming one) and are marked with gap:true. Jose's product decision (2026-08-11, research/decisions.md D2): broad scope -- these interactions are PLANNED as an advanced wave (scope:'planned'), not dropped.
